items.stem: In the following diagram showing dispersion of white light by a glass prism, the colours ‘P’ and ‘Q’ respectively are −

options.label: A
options.text: Red and Violet

options.label: B
options.text: Violet and Red

options.label: C
options.text: Red and Blue

options.label: D
options.text: Orange and Green

items.answer: (b) Violet and Red. When a narrow beam of white light passes through a prism, it splits up into a band of seven colours. Splitting of white light into its seven constituent (acronym VIBGYOR) colours on passing through a dispersive medium, i.e. the glass prism, is called dispersion of light. The order of deviation of colour from most to least is: Violet > Indigo > Blue > Green > Yellow > Orange > Red. Thus, here the colour P is Violet and colour Q is Red.

items.answer: (c) Assertion is true but Reason is false. Planets are much closer to the earth and are thus seen as extended sources. items.answer: (a) Both Assertion and Reason are true and Reason is the correct explanation of Assertion. Primary rainbow is a result of a three-step process: 1. Refraction at the first surface of the raindrop. 2. Total internal reflection from the second surface of the raindrop. 3. Refraction again from the first surface of the raindrop, from where the light finally emerges out. The intensity of light is reduced at the second reflection and hence the secondary rainbow is fainter than the primary rainbow.
